judge_summary_ja: Gold chain requires discord.exe spawning cmd.exe with the full command line `C:\Windows\system32\cmd.exe /q /d /s /c "undefined\NVIDIA^ Corporation\NVSMI\nvidia-smi.exe"`, followed by cmd.exe executing the /c command. The candidate reports only one observed action: cmd.exe file_access to `C:\Windows\System32\ctiuser.dll`, with no Discord parent, no /q /d /s /c command line, no NVIDIA/nvidia-smi object, and no supporting CBC parent_path/process_cmdline or tracing evidence for the gold behavior. Under the strict item rubric, only the generic C09-S02 subject token cmd.exe receives partial item credit; the candidate does not recover either gold behavior step as an action.
